Name: Alawishus Pixel
Overview: Alawishus Pixel is a retro-style puzzle platform game. A nameless young man in a hoodie has wandered into a cave, and the only way out is forward. The only way out of each room is to push a block onto a yellow switch, which will open a door leading to the next room. Many rooms contain hazards like ogres, bats, and lava, and one touch will kill the hero. Many rooms also contain signs left by a previous traveler, offering hints, instructions, and sometimes insane rambling. The player has infinite lives, and can reset the stage if it becomes unsolvable. The game features 40 puzzles to solve, and allows the player to return to any previously-visited stage through the options menu.
